presets.name: Sepia
presets.description: The style is one ink color on one ground, so a sepia treatment is the whole picture at once.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.description: The quietest set here. Nothing competes with the page around it.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: Deep teal on mint, two colors total.
presets.description: Line Face draws with exactly one ink on one ground, which makes it the one style where a duotone is not an approximation.

presets.name: Inverted
presets.description: Swaps ink and ground. There is no filled shape to dissolve here, only the stroke, so the inversion is clean.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Six dusty grounds under the same brush.
presets.description: The style ships six warm grounds. This trades them for dusty tones that sit further from cream.

presets.name: Electric
presets.summary: Black brush on six acid grounds.
presets.description: The other direction: six grounds past anything the style ships, with the brush left black so it survives them.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.description: The lightest way to make a set of avatars feel like it belongs together.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient under the brush.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.description: Uses scale rather than color. The style leaves a lot of air around the strokes, and cropping in buys it back.
